You raise an interesting point. Belize is independent, but it still has King Charles III as its constitutional head of state, represented locally by the Governor-General. The country’s elected government and National Assembly handle its public finances and day-to-day governing.
The bigger question of whether Belize should keep the monarchy, become a republic, or explore more cooperative economic models is ultimately something Belizeans themselves have to decide. I appreciate you sharing your perspective
